overview: A full-stack personal tech portfolio for Sagar M H — Java Developer & Spring Boot Engineer. Features auto-typing hero animation, scroll-triggered animations, certificate uploads, a protected admin dashboard for managing all portfolio content, and an AI recruiter chat that lets hiring managers ask questions about Sagar's skills, experience, and projects.
features: Auto-typing hero cycling through 6 developer roles
Scroll-triggered fade/slide animations on all sections
Certificate & resume uploads via secure file storage
Protected admin dashboard to manage projects, certs & resume
AI Recruiter Chat — recruiters can ask questions and get profile-based answers
Fully responsive on mobile and desktop
